notes.title: Animation Studio Manager has been released!
notes.content:
Hello Animators - It's time! Animation Studio Manager is fully released and is launching with a week-long sale!

Grow your Studio from making Short Webisodes to Award-Winning Feature Films where you can compete against your mentor-turned-nemesis, your Mother!

She might not have any confidence in you, but I do! Prove her wrong, and I'll see you at the Awards Show. With a little luck and a corrupted Soul, maybe you can be the one to sweep the whole show and win all the Awards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/3f70b563262e6a0fda6da96b809fae6042d24a44.gif

Just don't go bankrupt and prove she was right all along! 

Updates:

 Players can no longer acquire the Early Bird (Early Access) designator on their Nametag since the game has transitioned out of Early Access.
 SaveGame files that are older than 2 weeks old (prior to build 78) will be deleted to ensure everything works with level 9 Final Perk & the level 10 endings.
 Minor text updates throughout.

notes.title: Level 10!
notes.content:
Hello Animators! Level 10 is here!

Minus any final balancing, bug fixing, polishing, this is the full game!

Let me know in the Steam forums if you run across any issues, so I can fix them prior to the full release next month!!

I hope you enjoy!

Level 10
	Mom has watched your performance as you've grown from a beginner to a competitor. She doesn't want this dance to continue, so she is ready to challenge you to an Award Show Brawl - whoever loses must quit!
	
	Once you accept her challenge, level 10 begins.
	
	Skip to Friday is disabled for Level 10 because mom wants you to suffer through her weekly sabotages! Each week, you'll get a Paparazzi update that explains this week's sabotage. You'll also be able to earn Bonus Award Points each week based on how well a particular Production Department is doing that week. 

Sabotages
		In addition to unleashing daily attacks of either P.R. Disasters, Hackers, Viruses or Paparazzi news alerts (depending on the week), she also introduces a few daily minigame challenges that happen on weeks 2, 4, 6.

Door Hack (Week 2)
		Hackers change your door code every morning. A door code sequence will flash on the keypad. You must match the sequence to enter the building and continue your day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/b1d41a5eee8694fa3d8038d306a611bac32eece4.jpg

Pipe Rewire (Week 4)
		Hackers sent a virus to your plumping purification system and now all your waste is dropping directly into the ocean! You must locate the icons hidden underground to get the pump working again. Underneath the pump, you'll see the sequence you need for that week. Locate and click on those items in order to get the water purifier working again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/8308d169e0ff81244fe4e8a8b2f097f63d8f93d7.jpg

Don't Bomb! (Week 6)
You are given a series of chests to pick from, each chest either contains Awards or a Bomb. The first pick is a gimmie and you earn 50 points. But is that enough? You can keep going and earn up to 700 Award Points…but you also might find the bomb and lose 500!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/c92ad3bfa121ca240506409804e171d2647f3c7c.jpg

Final Awards Show
It all comes down to this. After 6 weeks of torture, it's time to show Mom and the Animation world what you're made of!

If you win, you just might earn a party on her yacht. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/a852e6a7fba0b737dbad6ffd79208d273c591210.png

Fixes

 Fixed a glitch that was preventing Paparazzi Room Tips from appearing.
 Fixed a glitch that was preventing the Matching Game text from appearing
 Fixed a glitch where a Fan Demand would remain visible with its timer frozen if you were preparing a Fan Convention. Now the Fan Demand is fulfilled if a Fan Convention is running or being prepared.
 Fixed a glitch where the Executive would re-explain how Seasons work if you had completed one season, didn't start building a second one, saved the game and reloaded.
 Fixed a glitch when retraining a Corporate Employee, sometimes the Employee count would get assigned to the wrong Department.
 Fixed an issue that made the wrong menu pop up if you tried to access the options menu while in a hard-mode game
 Red Carpet Dash

 Fixed a glitch where, after collecting the final Inventory Item it still showed another item on the bucket.
  Fixed a glitch that would freeze the game in Hard mode if you successfully completed the minigame.

Balancing & Quality of Life

 When your mouse hovers over the "Risky Business" icon, it previously only showed if there was an active Perk/Pain, but now it also shows if you received a "Risky Oops", Jackpot, Inventory reward, or Nothing.
 Balanced Award Points, mostly lowering the Hard Mode points for the T-Pose Awards as it was very difficult to win unless you turn on absolutely everything and do well in the minigames.
 Made the To-Do list a little wider so it reads better
 Previously if you got a Risky Business Jackpot, there was a 3% chance you got a 10X Super Jackpot. That has been balanced to a 10% chance of a 3X bonus.
 At level 9, Mom will always win Best Picture still, but she is only guaranteed a sub-category win the first time you play against her. After that, she'll only win a sub-category if she has more points, instead of "cheating" to ensure at least one every time.

notes.title: Late-Game Balancing
notes.content:
Hello Animators -

The game is nearly complete! Level 10 is on the test sever undergoing final balancing with Mom's Challenges and final 3 minigames before the final Award Ceremony!

Additionally, I've done a graphics optimization and cleaned up a bunch of assets, so even with all the level 10 stuff I've added, the game is now nearly 2 GB smaller!

I've done some late-game balancing and other fixes, listed here:


 Switched the new game starting month to April to reflect the new April final release date.
 Minor text/graphic fixes/clarifications
 Adjusted how the Inventory Rewards of Risky Business payout so it's more useful early on without going overboard in the late game.
 Did a complete overhaul of the Hint Popup system to prevent any issues if multiple hints try to pop up at the same time.
 Made the clickable region larger for upgrading each Entourage member. You can now click anywhere on the vertical region for that Entourage member.
 Fixed a glitch where the "Mega Audience Booster" would allow you to click it if you had 100 Inventory instead of 250.
 Fixed a glitch where if you load a saved game at level 9 while the current game has the "Office" button "Level Up" overlay, it wouldn't reset the button to say "Office".
 PR Disaster 

 The "Fan Sacrifice" option now also sacrifices Rotted Potato Score. However, this also allows you to use the button when your Fan Rating was previously too low to be used.
 If you use "Employee Sacrifice" and lose HR, IT or Security, it now turns off their Toggles if you don't have enough Employees anymore to use them.
 Fan Conventions

 You can now cancel Fan Conventions. If you Cancel during the planning phase, you lose a lot fewer Fans than if you cancel during the actual Convention.
 Lowered the amount extra you make when a Film goes viral during Fan Conventions.
 Award Show / Minigames

 Fixed an issue where the Finding Balance score bar masking was interfering with the character eyelid masking
 Fixed an issue in the Red Carpet Dash where one of the eyelid options were layered wrong.
 The Award Show now has an audience silhouette to add to the atmosphere. 
 Fixed a glitch that would sometimes prevent Mom from winning a sub-category Award in Level 9.
 Fixed a glitch where sometimes the Player would win a Level 9 sub-category Award, but it would show a competitor's Film cover.
 Adjusted the Mom Award Winning Bar Icon to make Mom letters bigger

 Entourage 

 Added some clarity about using your Entourage Points,

 Added text update when you have fully upgraded your Entourage.

 "Skip To Friday"

 This wasn't very visible before, so now it has replaced the obsolete "Help" button above the play/pause toggle at the bottom-left of the screen.

 When you hover over it, a little message pops up, explaining either why you can't use it now, or what will happen if you DO use it.

 Player Avatar

 Award Show

 Mom Challenge Initiation

 Level 10 is being developed, but with this hotfix comes the groundwork for accepting Mom's final Challenge.

 Or if you've already finished the To-Do list and delayed her Challenge, but don't create an Award-Eligible film, she will still prompt you again for a challenge.

notes.title: Character Creator, Employee Entourage & Red Carpet Dash
notes.content:
Hello Animators!

It's time for some exciting news: With this update, Levels 1-9 are complete (pending any final balancing)! Over the next few weeks, I will be heavily testing and balancing these levels as well as getting Level 10 on the test branch of the server for final testing.

Because with Level 10 - where you'll face off against your Mom as she wages all-out War on your Animation Studio - the game will be complete! So, that's exciting and coming very soon!

Okay, so let's dive into what's new with this update:

New!

Player Builder

 Now when you start a new game, you create your own Avatar before creating your Mom Avatar.
 Your Avatar appears on your OMBd page now instead of the silhouette.
 Your Avatar now is the one at the level 8 Awards minigame instead of the Animator.
 Your Avatar is also the one playing the new level 9 Awards minigame as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/ca49f9969f25e3de75e5f0ec5fdbced724d2c96f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/01c31d1e8dba3ca26b0facfc946bb410bae2cee7.gif

Entourage

 You can now unlock the Entourage in the Producer's Office at level 9. It costs 200XP to unlock it.
 You have 10 Members of your Entourage who each have their own Perk
 Each Perk can be upgraded up to 10 times using Entourage Points
 Earn Entourage Points doing the weekly Entourage Card matching game. 

 It costs 50 XP each week to run the matching Game
 Match 10 pairs of Entourage members to earn up to 15 Entourage Points each week
 For each Department you don't match up, they will suffer a drop in happiness!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/a541f6a5c11d8c9e9ee2d9fb6fe17bb9716206fb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/9c0a6008b9c06938f52d0ce215ab06663f5123b0.jpg

Red Carpet Dash

 At level 9, you unlock the final Award Ceremony minigame - the Red-Carpet Dash - which begins after you complete the Finding Balance minigame.
 This minigame is a variation of the grapple variation of the Catch a Break weekly minigame, except instead of catching one specific Inventory, you must collect a sequence of Inventory. If you collect the full sequence, you earn the maximum points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/dfa75230e3ff76ebfa375ec3834c83f44bade252.gif	

Tutorials

 Since Tutorials have had a major revamp, everyone's hints have been reset to see them all again.

 Once you see the new Hint, the game should remember that you've seen it and won't show it again unless you reset hints manually, or click "Play as guest"
 Once you unlock the Level 9 Entourage, you'll be able to skip the tutorial for future play-throughs if you want.

 Barista Hint now pops up in the Coffee Room to ensure the player knows how to switch to Barista mode
 A few Hints were removed as they are redundant due to other changes.
 Producer/Executive Tutorials

 Producer Level 5 : He now shows you his office before moving on to HR. This ensures the player sees the Department of the Week and knows where future upgrades will be.
 Executive Level 6:

 Fixed an issue that happens if all the Production people were out of the office when the Executive is trying to show you how to do Training - which requires at least one person to be in the office.
 Also explains that you earn Rotted Potatoes from TV movies in here now

 Producer Levels 6-8: The Producer now guides you through the new features instead of just talking about them in his meeting.
 Level 9: Once you unlock the Entourage, the Producer gives you his final guidance.

 All Minigame and Coffee Room Hints have been converted to videos instead of still images so you can see how the minigames operate a little better before playing.

 This includes the Award show minigames where Mom is texting instructions. You also get a video hint popup for these.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/514a98f3e8b1d1e867a40ca4015260924c2b3a8d.gif


		
Random

 "Catch a Break" 

 Swapped Editor character to the Animator.
 Removed the 4 hour "resting" time for the selected Department.

 Finding Balance

 Starts with 20 in each bucket in Easy mode
 Fixed a glitch where your fan rating would INCREASE if you failed instead of decreasing it.

 To-Do list

 Fixed a small glitch on the Level 2 To-Do list, due to last update's balancing
 Level 9 no longer requires PR Disasters (as those happen automatically). Instead, you must earn a certain amount of Entourage Points, based on your difficulty level.

 Ensured that the Award Points were being calculated properly on the Studio Clipboard and the actual Film!
 Moved the ability to "Name" Mom to the bottom of her creator page.
 Fixed a glitch where some "Media Focus" Producer Perks weren't calculating properly

 Added more mom Taunting

notes.title: Small Update: Level 7-9 Balancing & Fan Convention Overhaul
notes.content:
Hello Animators, I've got a small balancing patch for you here!

Small Fixes:

 Renamed the Blue Clipboard "Studio" instead of "Crew" to more accurate describe it.
 Ensure that Mom doesn't win the same Sub-Award twice in a row during the T-Pose Awards	

Balancing for Levels 7-9

 Lowered the Instant and Royalty Payouts for the two big TV series. They were a bit OP after the last update.
 Increased the punishment for failing to win anything at an Awards Show.
 Added better indication that "Entourage" is coming in the next big update.
 Fan Rating starts to Decay in Level 8, based on the difficulty level and your Corruption
 You must create one of all three sizes of Fan Conventions (see next section)

Fan Convention Revamp

 To start a Fan Convention, first you make a few selections. You choose size of the venue, the quality of the food and entertainment, how much you will spend on Ads & Deals and how many days the Convention will last.
 Next, you pay the initial Money fee, Ads & Deals, and you earn the Fan Rating right away since you are "announcing" the event, and the Producer can begin preparing the Convention. The length of time is based on the factors you selected, as well as whether or not you paid to "Rush" the preparation.
 While Preparing and Running a Fan Convention, your new level 8 Fan Decay is reversed, and you slowly gain Fan rating instead.
 Once the Fan Convention has been prepared, it begins automatically. Now it uses the entire Production Room, instead of just half of it, but you gain the perk of EVERY Fan Film you create during the Fan Convention will go Viral and make extra money!

notes.title: Major Update: Level 9! Rebalancing! Tutorials!
notes.content:
Hello Animators and welcome to the GREAT BIG UPDATE!!

When Animation Studio Manager first entered Early Access a few months ago, I got lots of feedback from streamers and players. They liked the potential of the game, but it was rough. Over the last several months, I've been working hard to add tutorials, rebalancing and add lots of depth to the first 8 levels.

Additionally, level 9's initial rollout has begun! There are a couple level 9 features that aren't finished yet and will be included in another update coming in a few weeks - in fact, I'll be releasing a "Road Map to Completion" next week!

But for now, let's dive into the full list of updates:

Level 9!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/e2638738b6adfbdc2899316dd189c8f04a1042d3.png

 Now when you finish level 8 and click on the To-Do list, it continues on to level 9!
 Mom pops up to note that you two are now rivals and enemies.
 Instead of choosing a normal Corruption Perk, you are given a final Perk based on your current 
 The Publicist now has access to his Level 9 Booster
 Production Employees now have their level 9 Awards Upgrades
 The final Media type is unlocked: 'Awards Bait Film'.

T-Pose Awards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/b573180eb441bb70004afd4841dac089d21b7930.png

 As Mom notes during the Level 9 sequence, you are now competing against Mom!
 The Awards go like normal, except you have more Coins for Pontification and must answer a few more questions for the Paparazzi.
 There will be an additional minigame in the next update as well.
 Mom texts you to briefly taunt each time she wins an Award
 Mom will always win the Best Picture Award while you're in Level 9, and she should win at least one of the sub-category Awards as well. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/42ab31541a6776dea35c218c81e35527a13e723e.png
P.R. Disasters
As a full-blown Studio, you have a lot of moving pieces and sometimes things go wrong. That's what these Disasters are all about.
An issue will arise involving a piece of Inventory (Dialog, Storyboards, Scenes, or Designs) and you have three choices to deal with it:
[olist]Ignore it and Sacrifice some Employees. Depending on your XP Loyalty, you could lose nearly half of your Employees in each Department.
Ignore it and Sacrifice your Fan Rating. Depending on your Minimum Fan Rating Soul Perk level, you could lose up to 50% Fan Rating.
Fix the issue. If you started Level 9 with the Pure Perk, you'll need 100 of the problematic Inventory and 250 Positive PR. If you got the Corrupt Perk, you'll need 500 of the Inventory, 500 PR, $1,000,000 and 4 Soul Portions. 
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/daba21f9ad3f2e6bbd56e7e067d8a0bac6bb3f62.png
Computer Apps

 Inventory Market Buy/Sell complete rebalance
 Several Apps got a Help Button that explains the App a bit. 
 New App - Plant the Seeds of Pontification

At level 8, you get an App that allows you to "mention" a Genre each week to start the judges thinking about that Genre.
You can do this once each week between Awards Ceremonies (6 weeks). If you pick the same Genre each week and then submit an Awards Film with that Genre, they judges have a much greater chance of picking that Genre as their favorite, giving you bonus Award Points. (combine this with the Writer's levels 7 & 9 upgrades to guarantee they will love your work!)
 Your mentions reset each Award Show, though, so you must come back each week.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/f7a8a5fd710190d291af7eee1e4155913043dc50.png
 New App - Finding Balance

At level 8, you get an App that allows you to trade Rotted Potato Score for Finding Balance minigame points.
In the minigame, you are trying to reach 100 Points in each bucket. For every 10% Rotted Potato Score you trade in, you start with 5 points in both buckets.
You can trade 10% each week between Awards Ceremonies (6 weeks), but the starting score resets each Award Show, so spend your Potatoes wisely and come back each week to keep boosting your score!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/cbe429a0b578119361ab507003a6b36eae65c358.png


Minigame Updates:
Hackers / Virus

 Overall

Happen more frequently now, based on your game mode (Easy, Medium, Hard)
I.T. and Security Toggles have also been increased to match these more frequent attacks. .
The more corrupt you are, the more likely you are to get Hackers/Viruses. Especially in Medium and Hard modes, corruption can even allow Hackers/Viruses overwhelm the Toggles
Added a variable to ensure a week between hackers/viruses

 Hackers

Added a down arrow for Hackers, so you can drop the number down, without having to go around the dial
Since the code is non-repeating, it now prevents you from selecting a number that has already been confirmed to be part of the code

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/0f432cb8f9e16adea37eec599c1d17cd9a0dbfe8.png
 Virus

 Now flashes the word "GO!" at the beginning of the game to ensure players know to begin.
 Better instructions for clarity, including some pictures for reference


Awards Minigames:

 Hot Seat Minigame

 A lot more Hot Seat questions.
 The answers that used to give 0 points now give 5 Points.

 Finding Balance:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/c011dd0f7e8fe7f273c092517fd8e3d3f2b3b2b8.png
 Clarified instructions
 Added a 3 second count-in before the game starts
 Added sound effects for winning or losing.
 Made Easy Mode a little easier by removing the "15" point options that fall.
 Added a little more time to the ending results because they were too fast to read.
 Side bars GLOW when you catch their basket.


Overall Rebalancing

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/058c9fc3faf2d3fe6c276259bfd5dc6fa925e406.png
Corruption/Soul Restoration:

Hiring Fees. Doubled the impact that Corruption has on Hiring Fees
Corruption Perk: XP. Dropped XP amount to 25XP for Slightly Corrupt and 100XP for Corrupt
Slightly lowered the Cash payout for the levels 7 & 8 Pure Level Perks
Due to Inventory Market rebalancing, Soul Restoration using Themes has been reduced back to its previous cost of 250 Themes

 Employee Bays

Quality Control's Bay size has been reduced to match the Artist and Composer, as that is closer to the actual ratio needed. 
**Due to this change, if you load a saved game, you will only have the Quality Control Department head, but none of your Employees.**
Editor & Sound Design Bay prices have gone up slightly, but Quality Control's Bay price went down

 Media/Film Inventory Requirements

Slightly balanced Ads/Deals & Publicity for Films
Lowered Animation Requirements overall
Increased Story Requirements to more closely match Animation throughout
To make Approvals/Quality Control less confusing, the number of Approvals is now more closely aligned with the other materials instead of being 4X higher. However, to compensate, that means Q.C. now works 4X slower. So basically, this doesn't change the economy at all, it just makes things less confusing. 

Extra Credit

Balanced Media Requirements to match new 'Make Media' ratios
Increased XP output in level 2 to 25XP.

Full TV Seasons

Increased amount of XP earn from Full Seasons to 50 / 100 / 250 / 500
At level 4, only the 11-minute TV Season unlocks to help focus the player on completing one season.
After creating the first Season, the Executive pops back up to explain that you can build your next season, but can't release another 11-minute until the previous one is canceled or renewed.
The 22-minute TV Seasons unlocks at level 5 and is now part of the To-Do list
The other two TV Seasons unlock at level 6, and the Streaming series is part of the To-Do list as well.

 Swag Bag

 Lowered costs of starting high tier from 250 Inventory to 100.
 Now Inventory requirements increase by 15 every time you use it.
 Perk values reduced from 5%/10% to 2%/5%

 To-Do List

 Level 3 now requires 4 more Writers instead of 2.
 Level 5 now requires you make another Season of TV.

 Achievements

 Genre Achievements have all been reduced to 10
 Total Media Achievements have been reduced to 500 / 2500
 Total Awards Achievements have been reduced to 10 / 25 / 50
 "Cream of the Crop" now requires a Rank 5 employee in all Corporate Departments as well as 
Production Departments
 17 new Achievements, mostly related to newer features.

 Fans

 Fan Demands happen slightly less frequently when your corruption is low, and more frequently as it gets higher.
 Ignoring the Fan Matching Game after level 6 now results in a loss of Fan Rating as well.

 Increase Production Upgrade: Corporate Training from 10XP to 25 XP
 If you go Bankrupt, you lose all Employees EXCEPT Department Heads. Previously, you lost all Department heads except the Producer.

Random Fixes/Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/da407cffba4b0a355fbada370a6765083c1ecf1b.png

  Hover over the "Risky Business" or "Catch a Break" navigation tabs, and a Popup appears showing you any active Perks, plus how long they will still be active.
  Added a fourth page to the Employee Clipboard for the Awards. Awards were previously stuffed at the bottom of the Media page, but it was way too crowded
  Level Up Article

 Has been clarified to be written by the Paparazzi News, which ties into the Paparazzi questioning you in the Awards Show.
 The 3 news links on the right side of the Article now show tips when you hover over them.

  Added a little movement to the tutorial characters so they're not just staring at your blankly!
  Added P.R. Disasters to the Help App
  The Media Tablet no longer has the "Film" button until you hit level 5 since you can't make them until then.
  Level 5 Tutorial - If you are playing with the tutorial on, after the Producer shows you the first two Corporate hires, the Executive takes over to show you where Corporate Training is, and shows you how to access Films on the Media Tablet.
  Level 7 Tutorial - The Executive explains a few things about winning awards. If you lose the awards show, the producer has a meeting right away (instead of waiting for the second failure)


Old saved games
Since things are really close to wrapping up with this update and the next - I will be cleaning up some code including some variables to allow old version save files to still work. As long as you load/save your files before the next update, you'll be fine. If you don't load those old games, then they will be deleted.

notes.title: Level 8 Awards Minigame and Office Computer Overhaul
notes.content:
Happy New Year, Animators! Today I have one more, big update to balance out the first 8 levels before I start getting into Level 9 in the next update!

Office Computer
Your Office computer is now more functional as a computer and has different Apps. These Apps include some features that were previously just in the office as well as some new ones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/6125d9ea987b7163acb78991c4b29cab6ec12398.jpg
New App - Swag Bag

 This Allows you to use Ads and Deals to directly boost your Fan Rating and your Rotted Potatoes
 You can also use the big Fan Swag Bag if you are dealing with a Fan Demand, but in that case, you won't get the Fan Rating boost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/ee1bd6f455289f531fc95cb8baa99f5294d1141f.jpg
New App - OMBd (Online Media Bulk Data)

 This keeps track of all the Media your Studio creates.

Hello and Happy Holidays!

More Character Immersion
New Year

Producer Tutorial
The Producer now instructs you on three topics if you're having trouble:

 At Level 5+, the first time your Corporate Issues get above 25%, the producer pulls you into a quick meeting to make sure you notice. This replaces a previous Pop-Up
 At level 6+, you can start getting Boycotted if your Fan Rating is too low. The first time this happens, the Producer lets you know what you need to do to fix it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/0adda0db1c46f05eb5b92e932c18e1e57b2350a5.png
	
Employee Bays
Just like in the Production Room where you can see each Department's Employees in their Bays, you can now see them in Corporate as well.
	
If you resume a previous save game, your current Corporate Employees should all become Rank 1 and should be visible in their Bays. Corporate bays don't need to be upgraded, they start at full capacity.


 Your Corporate crew will Rank up

 Track Walk-Outs / Poached Employees


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/e4a4f169b310c004d789872744a422acbb161adc.png
	
Corporate Crises
Previously, there were three types of Corporate Crises - Employee Fights, Computer Viruses and Hackers. However, these would just pop up and last 24 hours and there was nothing you could do about it, which was…pointless. 
	
Now Employee Fights have been removed, since Happiness is being impacted by enough other things, but the other two issues now prompt a quick challenge. How well you do at the challenge determines how many issues you receive. 
	
If you have the IT and Security toggles enabled, you are less likely to receive hacks/viruses, however, the more corrupt you are, the more likely you are to receive them.

Hackers
You are prompted to figure out a 5 digit code. Using brute-force guessing, you get three attempts to enter the correct code. If you get any digit of the code correct during any attempt, that digit locks into place.
	

 You can pay a large bribe to get the full code.
 You can pay a small bribe to get the first 2 digits.

notes.title: Glitches, Balancing, XP and Quality of Life
notes.content:
Welcome Studio Managers!

Let's dive into this update! We have some glitch fixes, some balancing, some new XP options, and some quality-of-life changes.

Level 1 Tutorial Adjustments
Did some minor changes to the Level 1 Mom Tutorial.

 Added Alerts/Employee Sickness to the tutorial. This helps motivate why you're learning how to earn XP for upgrades…to prevent sickness like this!
 Added a few more "Finger of Mom" pointing for a few items for clarity.
 Ambient noise now pauses when Mom pauses the during the Tutorial.
 When you begin level 2, Mom still pays for that first Friday - but now Text Message Alert pops up from Mom, reminding you that she is not paying for next week. She tells you to look at the Budget Board so you can be ready for what you will owe the following Payday. (This also removes the "sickness" Hint that would previously pop up with your first sickness.)

Awards Show Tutorial / Awards Minigames Updates
Awards Tutorial
When it's time to nominate a film and then go to your first Awards show, Mom shows up to guide you again like the intro tutorial.

Well - sort of. She sends you text messages this time like the level 2 Payday text message above. She's too busy to show up for this, especially since she expects you to lose your first Ceremony.

Once again, this eliminates about 5-6 Hint Pop-Ups in favor of a more "Story-driven" version of the explanation and creates a less intrusive experience.
Additionally, since Mom is texting throughout the Ceremony, she is able to send even more information than the Hint which only appears at the beginning of each screen once. This helps clear things up more.

"For Your Pontification" Update

 Writer Production Upgrades can now improve your chances of matching with the judges in this minigame.
 Lowered and rebalanced Bonus Points if you get multiple matches in one pull.
 Reduced number of Coins to 3 (level 7), 4 (level 8), 6 (level 9), 8 (level 10)

"Hot-Seat Interview" Update

 When the Question timer gets below 10 seconds, the timer turns red, and when it gets below 5 seconds, it begins beeping.
 SFX were added to the minigame.

Awards Ceremony Update

 Balanced Points the Opponents have to match new XP upgrades and Minigame changes
 Changed some wording for Clarity
 Game Pauses after the Award Show, and you must manually resume it. Players were wanting a moment to gather their thoughts in the Show Room before plowing through the rest of the week.
 Added Sound FX throughout Ceremony

Production Employee XP Upgrades
Currently at Level 5, you are prompted to upgrade your Production Employees using XP to complete Corporate Training. Now at Levels 7 and 9 (coming soon), you get additional, non-mandatory upgrades that will help you earn more Awards Points, have better Odds at Awards Show minigames, or give you more Royalties!

 At levels 7 & 9 (coming soon), click on the Production Employee's desk, then click the "Training" Tab, just like when you do "Corporate Training" at level 5.
 Writer / Editor Upgrades will help your chances at getting points in the Awards Show minigames
 Animator Upgrade will boost your Royalties
 Artist, Composer, Storyboard Artist, & Voice Director Upgrades will boost your base Awards Points, as well as the points for their specific Sub-Award category.
 Quality Control Upgrade will boost your base Awards Points.

To-Do List Adjustments

 Minor To-Do List balancing with Rotted Potatoes Scores (Levels 4 - 6) and Fan Conventions (Level 8)
 Numbers now count down on the list. For instance, if you need to hire 10 Animators, as you hire each one, the number will drop "10", "9", "8", etc. 
 Items have been reorganized on the To-Do list for legibility

Risky Business

 Risky Business is now reactive to your Corruption Level - the more Corrupt you are, the more likely you are to get the good perks instead of the bad ones!!
 Your first Risky Business always would give a Perk, now it specifically gives an Employee Speed Boost the first time you pull it - which is best, especially if you pull it during the Tutorial.
 Minor audio adjustments

Random Changes

 XP Clipboard now has an active 4th Perk - faster Media Cooldowns. It speeds up the cooldown by 25% each click (max 75% faster)
 If you click on Corporate Alerts, it now opens the proper Employee's door, just like it brings up the Employee File of the Production Employees.
 If you hover of the Happiness or Inventory of a Corporate Employee, it highlights their nameplate, similar to how the nametag appears on the Production Desks
 Increased the amount of Weekly Fan Rating you get from TV Seasons
 Reduced how frequently you get boycotted at level 6 if you have a low Fan Rating.

Bug and glitches

 Fixed an "Extra Credit" problem where submitting a training movie caused a problem when trying to receive XP or Money rewards after level 4.
 Fixed a glitch where you would hear the Ambient sound of working, even if you had 0 Employees if you had skipped the Tutorial and pressed Play prior to hiring your first Employee
 Fixed a glitch where you would still hear Ambient sounds while Employees were out Napping.
 Fixed some minor layering/clicking issues with the Alerts
 Fixed an issue where the "spending money" icon wasn't dying, so over long gameplays, it would start to lag
 Fixed a glitch where you could click the Coffee "Quick Brew" when you're in the Barista Room
 Fixed a glitch where if you were nominated for an Award while in your Office, the game would freeze.
 Fixed a glitch where if you selected Romance as your second Genre (TV Seasons or Award-Eligible Films), it usually wouldn't count toward the Steam Achievement
 Fixed a glitch that could make Fan Rating not save properly
 Fixed a minor glitch where the Fan Matching game was being seen as a Fan Demand in certain areas.
 Autosave (used for Bankruptcy rollbacks or game crashes) won't active on the Tutorial now - you shouldn't go back to the tutorial, you're in the real world now!

notes.title: Story Update & Early Game Rebalancing
notes.content:
Happy weekend!

There's lots of fun stuff in this update, so let's unpack it. 

Note - because there are so many changes to the early game, for the first time I am wiping Game-Saves. This won't impact achievements or anything, just any current games in progress. I have avoided doing this and have been able to implement new changes so far without losing save games, but at this point there have been so many changes, I felt it was better to start fresh!

The Storyline
The storyline of the game has been present, but fairly minimal so far - your Mother is a big-shot Producer and you are following in her footsteps...but she has no confidence in you.

This update takes you a lot deeper in that story

Mom Creator / Tutorial

The Mom intro has been revamped and she is no longer a shadowy figure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/8a6e5a729265a387f2780c3d78dc57e069eda992.gif

When you start a new game, you also get to design your Mom and name her. She is your Guide and Nemesis throughout the game. 

Levels 1-3 have been heavily rebalanced and sped up as Mom guides you to a full Production Studio.

 Level 1 is now a simple tutorial where Mom guides you through hiring your first 12 Employees, and making your first few pieces of Media.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/12a4ecc8dfe3e4d821855854d9c1f42d9a6e4aac.png
 Level 2 is unguided (Mom leaves and will come back once you've finished the level), but the To-Do list is more explicit in it's direction. You are free to do things your own way, but if you follow the To-Do list, it will guide you through the level quickly and help you understand the dynamics of the different Departments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/4eae0172decf03b0122d7b1777ae8f4a151a04a9.png
 In Level 3 Mom gives you her last advice and leaves. She is too busy to babysit you and is honestly surprised you're not bankrupt yet. This To-Do list has been rebalanced as well.
After that, Mom leaves you in the hands of a couple of her friends - an Executive and a Producer - who will guide you through levels 4-6 as you build up your Crew and hire a Corporate staff and prepare to start winning Awards at levels 7-8!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/4ca80e9e7548de49b54370ded74bb1920b62b117.png
Corruption Pathway
One of the major themes of the game is the idea that it's easier to get ahead in the Industry through corruption and shady deals than it is through quality artwork! Your Mom has clearly taken the pathway of Corruption, and following her would certainly make it easier to win Awards...but it comes at the cost of your Employee and Fan Happiness.

At the beginning of each level, you'll see a new article that mentions your Studio's rise under your Mom's supervision. The article will comment on your Corruption choices as the game goes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/6cd0e3d0b92130655e246608907e793ea3c85461.png

Following this article, you will be presented with a choice:

 A simple one-time Money payout
 A permanent Perk like reducing the cost of Employee Salaries or increasing Media Royalty
Of course, the Perk option will begin to Corrupt you. Corruption will only have a minor impact at the beginning, but as you go, your choices will start to add up with things like lowering happiness, making employees more likely to walk-out or get poached, and giving you less time to handle the Fan Demands of Level 8. These issues will compound greatly in the future level 9 (not currently available) when you start dealing with PR disasters.

Selling Your Soul
Corruption is also now connected to the current "selling your soul" features (you are able to trade portions of your Soul for Perks or Loans).

Selling your Soul now also contributes to your Corruption Level. You can restore your Soul Pieces, but the Corruption is permanent. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/460c5684bc362871494d5d240cc8bd689574a8c8.png

Balancing

As always, due to updates or player feedback, things get balanced around a bit!

Animators 

This was a highly requested issue as Animators are the biggest bottleneck of production - the number of Animators on a real production greatly outnumbers the rest of the departments - so for gameplay, I'm balancing it a little better. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/a159e1d2ee1fe969a24e91728f904176007d2b4c.png

 Now you only need to start with 4 Animators per Editor instead of 5 per Editor. Especially as you need a higher percentage of Animation in the future, this should dramatically reduce the number of Animators you need overall.

notes.title: Level 1 Tutorial, Employee Bays, Upgrades, Ranking and more!
notes.content:
Lots of Big Updates!!

First of all - to everyone who has played the game and loved or hated it, I appreciate your time and feedback! I have watched several playthroughs and seen the comments and frustration, so I hope this update solves a lot of these issues for you all!

Tutorial and Popups
To put it generally...level 1 didn't work well. Level 1 is very stripped down to help guide you through it, but failed to guide you through it. For those who made it past the first few levels, they really enjoyed the game and found it quite addictive, but others found the first few levels too confusing and tedious. Especially since the tutorial was delivered through a small, awkward text message! 

This all changes now!

Tutorial

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/2ffb2badd4437e259a8b39bdc86e22b4f31d87cb.png

The first level is now a simple tutorial. Your "Mom" guides and instructs you to hire your first few Employees and make a few different types of Media, showing you the basics of your economy.

And then you're ready for level 2. No need to grind out a bunch of Media for level 1!

Popups

Beyond the tutorial, there are also Popups that happen the first time a new event happens. This ensures that the player is aware of what is happening and how to deal with it.

These Popups include going into a new room, earning Money for the first time, clicking a new shiny button, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/333ed70f486a0ee04211efc4c8766f5fb903b43d.png

Random:		
 Made the Employee alert Popups more visible.
Added a giant Dollar Sign graphic with the word "Payday" that flashes on Payday as some players would miss that payday had passed.
Updated the "?" room popups
 Mom Text messages are now just her taunting you for story reasons, and isn't related to the tutorial
 Banker only pops up now if you go fully Bankrupt, and not if you're just negative on Payday.
If you go negative through a Payday, a red "X" now appears above your Money. If you miss two paydays, a second "X" appears. These both go away as soon as you get above $0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/621577e44e5c25e40768d949baf1ccd6af3f2896.png

Individual Department Employees

Another big issues players were having was the lack of visual representation of your entire crew.

As the "Studio Manager", you will always be more focused on the big picture, so the intent is for the Department Heads to do the "micro-managing" of the entire Department. While this is still true, it has become very obvious players strongly dislike each department being merely one desk and a number.
	
You will now see each Department's individual "bay" of Employees. You can see the individual status of any Employee in the Bay: if they walk-out, get sick, get Poached, etc. Additionally, I have added skill ranking for the Department Employees you hire. At first you hire Interns, but you can use XP to upgrade that and start out hiring better Employees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/9884be2c59bf3d9f5b76129e7e76f6e69e421aa4.png	

Production Department Bays

 Each Department starts with a limited number of Employees that it can hold.
 You can buy larger bays to double the number of Department Employees you can hire.
 You can upgrade it again for another double number of Employees.
 Instead of an overall Employee limit for the Studio, you just have Department limits. 
 **IF you load a previous save game file, everything should work, but if a department has more employees than its max Bay size (the second upgrade), then that Department will be reduced to fit the max bay.


Employee Ranking

 After hiring your Department Head, each subsequent Employee has a Skill Ranking.
 They will be hired as Interns and will grow every few weeks from Rank 1 to Rank 5.

  Rank 1 - Intern. 3 Weeks.
  Rank 2 - Novice. 3 Weeks. +10% Speed
  Rank 3 - Competent. 4 Weeks. + 15% Speed
  Rank 4 - Proficient. 5 Weeks + 20% Speed
  Rank 5 - Expert. + 25% Speed.

 Poaching will only happen on Rank 3+
 When you Fire employees, you'll start with the lowest ranked Employee. 
  If an Employee is sick now, it will be an individual Employee rather than the entire Department

Department Speed

 In addition to the other factors that impact speed, Each department has its own speed which was previously impacted by department happiness.
 Now that Department speed is also based on the average Rank of the Employees in your Department (see above for those numbers). 
 This means if you have several Rank 5 Employees, your average speed will be at 125%. However, if you hire a new Rank 1 Employee, that new Employee will have a normal 100% speed, which will make your Average speed drop down a little.


Extra Credit (Educational Videos) & Seasons

In addition to making individual Media that you sell for instant profit, you have two other options for creating Media.

Extra Credit
Each week you now have the opportunity to create an animated Educational Video about animation for your local community. Depending on your level, you will start making videos for an Art Community, then High School, Community College and finally a Film School.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/efeb91ff97ac24912aea7b7f1cd86ec119fe5a88.png

As a reward, you choose from three options: 

 A monetary payout (increases from levels 1-4).
 XP Points to be used for upgrades on the XP Board
 Inventory - The community can also make you some inventory that you can use  to build your own Media that you sell each week. (you receive the newest inventory you need for your level)


Seasons of TV
Seasons of TV already existed in the previous update, but have been explained better with the new popups. You can also earn XP with Seasons of TV.
	
Experience Points (XP) Upgrades
Previously, XP was only used for Corporate Training at Level 5, but now that has been expanded. 

 Health Care - Putting points into this will reduce how often your Employees get Sick.
 Loyalty - Putting points into this will reduce how likely it is that your Employees get Poached.
 Hiring Rank - Putting points into this will increase a department's starting Rank
 Coming Soon - A fourth Upgrade will be related to a feature that will be in the next major update (Minigame).
	
Use XP earned from Season of TV or Extra Credit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/9950fa223fa54f402b61d0492943f46982437243.png

Fixes and Balances

 In Hard Mode, Employees were Walking-Out and getting Poached too easily, so I toned down those numbers a little.
 In Hard Mode, happiness started a little bit too low for new hires, so I balanced that a little.
 Fixed a glitch where the To-Do list would still tell you to hire "1 more" Employee, even after you had hired enough and the checkmark had already appeared.
 Fixed a glitch where if your Season was getting renewed on the same Payday as a Negative Money bank alert, the two messages would overlap. Now you must close the Season renewal notification before you can open the Bank notification
 Replaced Department selection & pop-ups graphics (such as Alerts or Retraining). Previously it showed the Department head's face, but people were having trouble keeping track of all the character, so now you see the department's inventory instead. 
 Added the Corporate Inventory Icons to their Department's whiteboard overview, as there was no current clear indication of what inventory those departments made.
 The Fog on "Risky Oops" started too transparent, so it is now more opaque at first.
 Fixed a glitch where Employee of the Month - which shouldn't unlock until Corporate - was defaulting to Writer until Corporate was unlocked. This was causing the Writer to be shielded from certain negative effects.
 Balanced the Producer meeting again so now it's a nice brisk 90 seconds!
 Increased the amount you earn from selling your Soul from $10,000 to $20,000

notes.title: Animation Studio Manager Early Access Release Update!
notes.content:
Early Access Release Build of Animation Studio Manager!

Greetings! Thank you for coming, I hope you enjoy the game!

I've been hard at work the last few weeks finishing up the last of some new features and fixes as well as implementing some improvements based on some recent new player feedback!

One of the biggest issues was that the explanations for things were done via wall of text, so I fixed this by heavily reducing text and adding picture explanations for simplicity:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/e8ee415b4356e4a3f88ac5e7e77a57bd77234c1d.png

New!

Seasons
You can now choose to either make TV episodes now, or save them for use in a Full Season.

 Once you've created the full Season, you'll make a lump sum of money as well as weekly Royalties for the 12 weeks the season releases.
 Making Seasons is how you earn XP now as well
 Once a Season has finished airing, it might get renewed based on your Fan Rating and how long the show has been running.

 If it gets renewed, you have 4 weeks to begin the second season - otherwise it will just start over with a new series. 
 Note, you will be able to "design" your Season box set (similar to how you can currently design the Posters for your Award Nominees, but that's only Levels 7+…this brings the personalization to early game!)



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/8f1f80b41c0d41c1a4898c2ae247b4747a097a2a.png

XP Revamp

 XP has been completely reworked to be earned from created TV Seasons in level 2+
 XP can be used for several Studio-wide upgrades that will be available early game. (not active yet)
 XP can be used to give Corporate Training to Production Employees at Level 5
 XP can be used to give Award-Level upgrades to Production Employees at Level 7 (not active yet)


Poaching
If your Employees are unhappy, they might walk out, but before that, they now might get poached by your competition!

Steam Achievements
Added 10 new Steam Achievements - 5 of them are related to the new TV Seasons.
Brings total to 30 Achievements - all should be currently obtainable.

Fixes/Balancing

Balancing

 The first few levels have few items, so the time now goes by a bit faster to compensate. By level 5 it flattens back out to where it is, but that helps the first few levels flow even better
 Optimized a few things throughout the game.
 Minor balancing for Fan Rating and Rotted Potatoes
 Fan Matching Minigame, change scoring slightly:

 For every pair of matches found, you can +.3% Fan Rating
 For every time you miss, though you lose -.1% Fan Rating.
 This puts the score range of the game from -0.3% (no matches, all fails) to 1.5% (5 matches, no fails)

		
Fixes / Quality of Life

 Adjusted the "Catch a Break: Falling" bucket corners - previously it would bounce-out items that seemed like they should go in
 Fixed a memory leak that was causing lag spikes after a while.
 Fixed a glitch in the "View All" room where, if you click on a spot that is currently empty, but where a future poster might be, it still acts like it's clicking on something now.
 Fixed a glitch where if you were in the Risky Business or Catch a Break Room when they Banker Email went off, it would glitch when returning you to the room.
 "Skip to Friday" now closes the Media Tablet and Matching Games, so you can't continue to play those while skipping.
 When being alerted to a Boycott/Viral, it closes the Media Tablet. Now it reopens the Media Tablet after you close the alert.
 Fixed a glitch where the keyboard hotkey the "XP Board" was able to be triggered prior to unlocking XP.
 Risky Business

 Fixed a glitch that would give you Inventory for Departments that weren't unlocked yet.
 Fixed a glitch that would give "Coffee" perks and pains even if Coffee wasn't unlocked yet.

 Risky Oops!

 One of the outcomes of pulling the Risky Business lever is the "Oops" option, which results in one of the fog, water, flashlight or multi-color lights.
 If you don't use Risky Business for a week, though, the following week you run the risk of the Lever pulling itself and giving you one of the Oops outcomes!
 You also won't be able to use Risky Business again that week if it goes off on its own.


Mom 
Mom is the primary antagonist of the game who starts skeptical and doubtful of you, and turns jealous as the game goes on. I made some changes to make this more apparently through the game.

I plan to add a Character Creator option, where you will also get to design your Mom. For now, though, she is this shadowy figure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/d8562d734ccb7089ab957f71eeead43d7feb29b4.png

Early New Player Feedback
	A few new players have played recently, and I have adjusted some things as a result.

 Game Instructions - Overall, the instructions weren’t great. Text descriptions were too wordy, and everything was text. It needed pictures and a little more guidance on how to get started and "what to do next".

 Overall reduction of "wordiness" throughout the game's instructions and pop ups. Less is more … too much text and people stopped reading completely.
 Office Room now includes "Mom's Rules For Not Failing Your Company" for the first few levels to add to Mom taunting you, and to add to the hints.
 New Room Instructions now include pictures and far fewer words

 No More Variable Speed - The game previously had 3 gamespeeds, creatively labeled speed 1, 2 and 3. Some players were missing that they could go faster and were annoyed with the delay, and once they realized they could speed up, almost never wanted to go slower. So now, previous "Speed 3" is the only speed. If you need to catch up on things, press pause (or spacebar)
 Employee Intros: Some players were confused by the Employee Introduction appearing before you had hired one, so I delayed that appearing until you hired the first Employee of that department.
 Employee Ratios: Many players aren't reading the Employee speeds and realizing you need more Animators than Writers/Editors. This is leading to slow and bankrupt plays. I Updated the level 1 To-Do list to indicate you should hire 1 Writer, 5 Animators and 1 Editor to help you realize you need different ratios of different employees. After that, no ratios are directly given.
 Button Sizes: I made some buttons larger so they stand out more, and are easier to click!
 Widget PopUps (Phone, Soul Selling, Perks). When you hover over the phone Icon, the phone pops up. The phone stays visible, even if your mouse moves up to the phone to follow along as you read the text.
 Giant Pause button - Players were often not noticing the game was paused, so when in the production or corporate rooms, and the game is paused, a giant "PAUSE" icon fades on the screen for a couple seconds on an interval. Hopefully it's not intrusive, but helpful!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/239febb944ee08c24c22836b38fc5a35fd1b775b.png
			
	
Coming Soon
	
I wanted to make sure it was clear which features weren't currently available, so I marked them with a "Coming Soon" or similar tag. 
This includes:

 Volume Control
 Studio XP upgrades
 Main Menu Minigames
 Levels 9 & 10

Build 32

After a couple false starts, I got this build up and running. Mostly minor balancing and bug fixes, and making the Producer's Random Meeting go a bit faster for pacing.
